ننملخ (form VII)
# نَنْمَلِخُ (nanmaliḵu) /nan.ma.li.xu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# نَنْمَلِخَ (nanmaliḵa) /nan.ma.li.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# نَنْمَلِخْ (nanmaliḵ) /nan.ma.lix/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
